-﻿l_simp_chinese:
- nesnd_egypt_independence:0 "独立的代价"
- nesnd_egypt_independence_reason:0 "1825年的协定承认埃及摆脱奥斯曼的统辖，六国以保证独立换取在尼罗河沿岸投资的权利。王朝因而得到一段宝贵的喘息，却也把工场、学校和军队的前途交到了新的债权人面前。\n\n外国的机器与教师可以帮助我们扩充国力，外国资本对埃及经济的支配也会侵蚀自主。朝廷可以选择合作的对象，也可以撤回政治承诺。三十年之后，这个国家能否依然决定自己的命运，要由这些选择和它们留下的经济秩序回答。"

- nesnd_egypt_without_investor_status:0 "尚未承诺由一国主持投资。外国持有的经济份额：[JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('nesnd_egypt_foreign_share')|%1]。"
- nesnd_egypt_investment_accounts:0 "尼罗河的学堂与工场"
- nesnd_egypt_investment_accounts_reason:0 "购入机器容易，留下能够制造、修理和使用机器的人却要付出更多心力。大学要教出本国的技术人才，工具工场要供给生产所需的器械，新的工业也要招得到真正的工人。\n\n朝廷希望这些事业能成为埃及自己的立国之本。无论资本来自何处，学堂有人讲授、工场有人劳作，才算把纸上的许诺变成了国力。"

- nesnd_egypt_dependence_result:0 "独立性耗尽时，埃及将接受合格投资国的保护。若无人能够承担，或保护关系未能成立，王朝将承担保障落空的政治后果。"
- nesnd_egypt_investor_desc:0 "从仍然存在且独立的签约国中，选择能够承担保护责任的主要投资伙伴，以建设、教育与产业合作换取长期支持。印度的历史投资权益仍受1825年协定保障；其附属于南朝时，不能主持埃及的新投资安排。"

- nesnd_egypt.1.t:0 "独立的一代"
- nesnd_egypt.1.d:0 "维持自主的三十年，已经由一代埃及人亲自走过。外国商人仍有自己的资产，列强仍有自己的打算，但朝廷保住了决定国家道路的权力。今后的工场与学校，将为这一权力争取更坚实的根基。"
- nesnd_egypt.1.a:0 "让下一代接过它。"
- nesnd_egypt.2.t:0 "保护国协定"
- nesnd_egypt.2.d:0 "王朝已经接受投资国的保护。为工场、军备和学校引入的支持，最终变成了约束国家主权的关系。朝廷仍统治埃及，却必须在新的权力秩序中安排自己的前途。"
- nesnd_egypt.2.a:0 "承认已经签下的协定。"
- nesnd_egypt.3.t:0 "保障落空"
- nesnd_egypt.3.d:0 "独立的余地已经耗尽，朝廷却没有能够承担保护责任的投资伙伴。先前的发展和交易不会就此消失，王朝却失去了借外部支持证明自己能够维持独立的理由。"
- nesnd_egypt.3.a:0 "这份责任只能由朝廷承担。"
- nesnd_egypt.4.t:0 "知识落在土地上"
- nesnd_egypt.4.d:0 "大学已能培养技术人才，工具工场和新的主业工厂也招足了工人。过去写在合作文书中的愿望，正在埃及人的讲授与劳作中获得实际的力量。资本可以流动，这些已经形成的本领值得继续培育。"
- nesnd_egypt.4.a:0 "让学问与生产一同生长。"

- nesnd_canon_no_french_alliance_tt:0 "对方没有与法国结盟"
- nesnd_canon_request_1_desc:0 "争取德意志邦国的军事同盟，以共同承担大陆竞争中的风险。"
- nesnd_canon_request_11_desc:0 "为尚不能承担进攻同盟的德意志邦国提供相互防御的约定。"
- nesnd_canon_request_2_desc:0 "向欧洲资本开放投资，以支持联邦的工业和大陆军备。"
- nesnd_canon_request_3_desc:0 "请求法国以政治信用支持本国的意大利议程。"
- nesnd_canon_request_4_desc:0 "以防御协定保护意大利邦国，并为真正的干涉保留外交基础。"
- nesnd_canon_request_5_desc:0 "寻求能够维持本国经济发展的投资伙伴。"
- nesnd_canon_request_sent_tt:0 "向对方发出提议，等待答复。提议最多保留45日；六个月内不能再发起同类交涉。"
- nesnd_canon_accept_request_tt:0 "按来函所列条件作出承诺。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.t:0 "来自外国的提议"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.d:0 "一项外交提议送达了政府。使节正在等待答复。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.alliance:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('canon_sender').GetName]希望与我们缔结五年约束期的军事同盟。使节把德意志诸国的安全与法国支配的大陆秩序联系在一起，要求我们共同承担今后外交与战争中的风险。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.defense:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('canon_sender').GetName]提议缔结五年约束期的防御协定。对方希望各国的独立能够得到实际保护，也期待我们在受到进攻时履行相互援助的义务。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.credit:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('canon_sender').GetName]请求法国为其意大利议程提供六年的政治信用。支持者希望借法国的威望说服国内外各方接受这项事业；这份承诺本身不改变各邦的主权。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.investment:0 "[SCOPE.sCountry('canon_sender').GetName]愿以五年约束期的协定向我国投资者开放市场。它期待新的工场和技术，也将承担外资进入所带来的利益分配问题。协定给予投资的权利，企业是否动工仍取决于实际经营。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.a:0 "接受这项提议。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.1.b:0 "我们不能承担这份承诺。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.2.t:0 "使节带回了协议"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.2.d:0 "对方已经接受来函中的条件，双方议定的承诺也已成立。此后的合作将取决于各国是否继续履行这些义务。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.2.a:0 "履行我们的承诺。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.3.t:0 "交涉未能成立"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.3.d:0 "这次交涉没有留下生效的协议。对方未予承诺，或谈判期间的局势已使原来的条件无法成立。使节将带着这一结果返回。"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.3.a:0 "另寻时机。"
- nesnd_prussian_coalition:0 "德意志的共同防卫"
- nesnd_prussian_coalition_reason:0 "法国与莱茵邦联的秩序把德意志分成了许多各有依凭的邦国。普鲁士若要争取更大的发言权，不能只诉诸地图上的疆界，还必须让其他政府相信，它有能力也有意愿承担共同的风险。\n\n军事同盟和防御协约需要各国真正同意，军队和兵工则使这些承诺具有分量。尚受法国或莱茵宗主约束的邦国，必须先取得相应的外交自由，才能决定自己的立场。"
- nesnd_prussian_coalition_status:0 "争取三个不同德意志邦国的同盟或防御协约，并准备足够的陆军与兵工。"
- nesnd_prussian_subordinate_status:0 "宗属关系限制着独立外交；已有建设和协作经历仍然保留。"
- nesnd_prussian_rhine:0 "莱茵秩序的争夺"
- nesnd_prussian_rhine_reason:0 "共同防卫使各邦能够在法国面前发出更有分量的声音，却没有替它们决定德意志的最终归属。联盟可能瓦解，莱茵诸邦也可能自行摆脱外部支配；普鲁士还可以沿着统一的道路重塑这片土地。\n\n继续维持真实的协约和军备，才有共同参谋合作的基础。阿尔萨斯的主张则仍须通过外交和战争处理，纸上的宣称不会自行变成边界。"
- nesnd_prussian_rhine_resolved_tt:0 "普鲁士一系完成德意志统一，或法国不再统辖德意志邦国且莱茵邦联取得独立"
- nesnd_prussian_rhine_cooperating:0 "共同军备与协约仍在支撑莱茵政策。"
- nesnd_prussian_rhine_paused:0 "现有协作不足以维持共同参谋利益；此前的外交成果仍然保留。"
- nesnd_prussian_joint_staff:0 "德意志共同参谋合作"
- nesnd_prussian_rhine_settlement:0 "新的德意志地位"
- nesnd_austrian_italy:0 "意大利的均势"
- nesnd_austrian_italy_reason:0 "法国支持的共和事业、各邦王朝与教宗的权力，使意大利的统一同时成为欧洲秩序的问题。奥地利可以借防御协定保护仍然独立的邦国，也可以在真实的领土争端中承担干涉的代价。\n\n维持多国并立并非唯一结局。承认新的统一力量，也意味着承认维也纳的影响已有边界。每一次抉择都须面对眼前的盟约、军队与利益。"
- nesnd_austrian_waiting_status:0 "尚无可由奥地利干预的意大利领土争端。"
- nesnd_austrian_dispute_status:0 "[JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_austrian_enemy').GetCountry.GetName]正向[JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_austrian_target').GetCountry.GetName]施压。"
- nesnd_austrian_committed_status:0 "奥地利已加入目标方，等待这场争端的实际结果。"
- nesnd_austria_intervene:0 "出面保护意大利邦国"
- nesnd_austria_intervene_desc:0 "以军队承担防卫的承诺，并把奥地利的声望押在这场争端上。"
- nesnd_austria_intervene_tt:0 "加入当前意大利争端的目标方。争端结束后，获胜、领土失守与僵局分别决定奥地利的影响。"
- nesnd_austria_acknowledge:0 "承认这次秩序变化"
- nesnd_austria_acknowledge_desc:0 "不以奥地利的军队阻止眼前的领土与统一要求。"
- nesnd_austria_acknowledge_tt:0 "放弃干预本次争端，24个月内不再提出新的干涉。"
- nesnd_austrian_cooldown_tt:0 "距上次干预决定已满24个月"
- nesnd_austrian_current_dispute_tt:0 "有处于外交交涉期的意大利领土争端"
- nesnd_austrian_italian_commitment:0 "意大利干涉军费"
- nesnd_austrian_concession:0 "让步于意大利新秩序"
- nesnd_austrian_italian_defeat:0 "意大利干涉受挫"
- nesnd_austrian_italian_influence:0 "意大利防卫声望"

- nesnd_europe_america.2.t:0 "莱茵秩序已变"
- nesnd_europe_america.2.d:0 "此前束缚德意志诸国的秩序已经改变。统一的实现或外部支配的退却，使我们取得了新的地位。此前的协作留下了政治与军事经验，今后的秩序仍要由各方继续争取。"
- nesnd_europe_america.2.a:0 "新的地位，新的责任。"
- nesnd_europe_america.3.t:0 "奥地利作出承诺"
- nesnd_europe_america.3.d:0 "奥地利已经加入这场意大利争端的防卫一方。使节的许诺如今有了军队与军费的支持，维也纳的声望也将承受争端结局的考验。"
- nesnd_europe_america.3.a:0 "兑现防卫的承诺。"
- nesnd_europe_america.4.t:0 "意大利防卫得胜"
- nesnd_europe_america.4.d:0 "这次争端中的对手已经接受了实际的战争要求，受保护的邦国也保住了自己的地位。奥地利在意大利事务中的发言权因此得到了一段新的支撑。"
- nesnd_europe_america.4.a:0 "让各邦记住这份承诺。"
- nesnd_europe_america.5.t:0 "干涉未能保全秩序"
- nesnd_europe_america.5.d:0 "奥地利的干涉没有保住所要维护的地位。领土要求、宗属变化或邦国的消亡，使原来的承诺落了空。维也纳必须面对这次失败在意大利留下的影响。"
- nesnd_europe_america.5.a:0 "承认这次挫败。"
- nesnd_europe_america.6.t:0 "没有胜者的交涉"
- nesnd_europe_america.6.d:0 "这场争端已经结束，奥地利没有取得足以宣称获胜的结果。受保护的一方仍然存在，双方却都必须在未被彻底解决的分歧中寻找下一步。"
- nesnd_europe_america.6.a:0 "先让军队归营。"
- nesnd_europe_america.7.t:0 "边疆要求已经实现"
- nesnd_europe_america.7.d:0 "联邦取得了此次要求的东洲领地。使节提出的边疆主张已经改变了实际国界，军队与支持扩张的工商利益也从中获得了新的声望。"
- nesnd_europe_america.7.a:0 "治理已经取得的土地。"
- nesnd_europe_america.8.t:0 "边疆交涉告一段落"

- nesnd_europe_america.8.a:0 "先处理眼前的结果。"
- nesnd_europe_america.10.t:0 "联邦提出领土要求"
- nesnd_europe_america.10.d:0 "美国政府已经要求取得[SCOPE.sState('nesnd_usa_disputed_state').GetName]。联邦使节把它称作恢复应有的边界，而当地居民、地主和驻军所面对的却是实在的主权争夺。东洲政府必须通过眼前的外交博弈决定如何应对。"

+ nesnd_prussian_coalition:0 "德意志的共同防卫"

- nesnd_egypt_independence:0 "The Price of Independence"
- nesnd_egypt_independence_reason:0 "The settlement of 1825 recognized Egypt’s release from Ottoman rule. Six powers guaranteed its independence in return for investment rights along the Nile. The dynasty gained breathing room, while its factories, schools and army acquired new creditors.\n\nForeign machinery and teachers can strengthen Egypt; foreign control of its economy can also erode its freedom of action. The government may choose a partner or withdraw its political commitment. Whether Egypt can still determine its own future after thirty years will depend on those choices and the economic order they leave behind."
- nesnd_egypt_with_investor_status:0 "Current partner: [JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_egypt_investor').GetCountry.GetName]. Foreign share of the economy: [JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('nesnd_egypt_foreign_share')|%1]."

- nesnd_egypt_investment_accounts:0 "Schools and Workshops of the Nile"
- nesnd_egypt_investment_accounts_reason:0 "Machinery can be purchased more quickly than a country can train the people who build, repair and operate it. Universities must educate local specialists, tooling workshops must supply equipment, and new industries must attract workers.\n\nThe government seeks an enduring foundation for Egyptian power. - nesnd_egypt.1.t:0 "A Generation of Independence"
- nesnd_egypt.1.d:0 "A generation of Egyptians has lived through thirty years of independent government. Foreign merchants retain their property and the powers retain their ambitions, but the government has preserved the right to choose the country’s course. Its future factories and schools can give that right firmer foundations."
- nesnd_egypt.1.a:0 "Let the next generation inherit it."
- nesnd_egypt.2.t:0 "The Protectorate Settlement"
- nesnd_egypt.2.d:0 "The dynasty has accepted its investment partner’s protection. The support brought in for factories, armaments and schools has become a relationship that constrains national sovereignty. The government still rules Egypt, but must now find its place within a different order."
- nesnd_egypt.2.a:0 "Recognize the settlement."
- nesnd_egypt.3.t:0 "The Guarantee Fails"
- nesnd_egypt.3.d:0 "Egypt’s room for independent action has been exhausted, with no current investment partner to assume its protection. Earlier development and transactions remain, but the dynasty can no longer appeal to outside support as evidence that it can preserve independence."
- nesnd_egypt.3.a:0 "The government must answer for this."
- nesnd_egypt.4.t:0 "Knowledge Takes Root"
- nesnd_egypt.4.d:0 "Universities are training specialists, while tooling workshops and a major industry have filled their workplaces. - nesnd_egypt.4.a:0 "Let learning and production grow together."

- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.2.d:0 "The other government has accepted the terms, and the agreed undertaking is now in place. Further cooperation will depend on both countries continuing to fulfil their obligations."
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.2.a:0 "Honour our commitment."
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.3.t:0 "Negotiations Without Agreement"
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.3.d:0 "These negotiations have produced no effective agreement. The other government either withheld its commitment or circumstances changed before the original terms could be settled. The envoy will return with that outcome."
- nesnd_canon_diplomacy.3.a:0 "Wait for another opportunity."

To gain a stronger voice, Prussia must persuade other governments that it is both able and willing to share their risks.\n\nAlliances and defensive pacts require genuine agreement. An army and armaments industry give those commitments weight. States still bound to France or a Rhenish overlord must first secure the diplomatic freedom to choose their position."

- nesnd_prussian_rhine_reason:0 "Common defence gives the German states a stronger voice before France, but does not settle Germany’s future. - nesnd_europe_america.1.t:0 "A German Commitment"
- nesnd_europe_america.1.d:0 "Three German states now cooperate with us through real agreements. The army and armaments industry give common defence a material foundation. The states retain their own governments, and the value of their cooperation depends on continued observance."
- nesnd_europe_america.1.a:0 "Let the staffs begin their work."
- nesnd_europe_america.2.t:0 "A Changed Rhenish Order"
- nesnd_europe_america.2.d:0 "The order that constrained the German states has changed. Unification or the retreat of outside domination has established a new standing for our country. Earlier cooperation has left political and military experience, while the future order remains to be shaped."
- nesnd_europe_america.2.a:0 "A new standing brings new responsibilities."
- nesnd_europe_america.3.t:0 "Austria Commits"
- nesnd_europe_america.3.d:0 "Austria has joined the defending side in the Italian dispute. Diplomatic assurances now carry military and financial commitments, and Vienna’s prestige will share in the outcome."
- nesnd_europe_america.3.a:0 "Honour the pledge of defence."
- nesnd_europe_america.4.t:0 "The Defence of Italy Succeeds"
- nesnd_europe_america.4.d:0 "The opposing power has accepted demands in this dispute, and the protected state has preserved its position. Austria’s voice in Italian affairs has gained renewed support."
- nesnd_europe_america.4.a:0 "Let the states remember our commitment."
- nesnd_europe_america.5.t:0 "Intervention Fails to Preserve the Balance"
- nesnd_europe_america.5.d:0 "Austria’s intervention has failed to preserve the position it sought to defend. Territorial demands, subordination or the disappearance of the protected state have undone the original commitment. Vienna must face the consequences in Italy."
- nesnd_europe_america.5.a:0 "Acknowledge the setback."
- nesnd_europe_america.6.t:0 "A Dispute Without Victory"
- nesnd_europe_america.6.d:0 "The dispute has ended without a result Austria can claim as a victory. The protected state survives, but the disagreement has not been decisively settled. Both sides must consider their next course."
- nesnd_europe_america.6.a:0 "Let the troops return for now."
- nesnd_europe_america.7.t:0 "The Frontier Demand Is Fulfilled"
- nesnd_europe_america.7.d:0 "The federation has acquired the $HUS$ territory demanded in this dispute. Its frontier claim has changed the actual border, bringing new prestige to the army and the commercial interests supporting expansion."
- nesnd_europe_america.7.a:0 "Govern the land we have acquired."
- nesnd_europe_america.8.t:0 "The Frontier Dispute Closes"
- nesnd_europe_america.8.d:0 "This dispute has not delivered all the requested land to the federation. The claim remains, but declarations cannot substitute for possession. The government will close this round before deciding its next course."
- nesnd_europe_america.8.a:0 "Address the result before us."

- nesnd_europe_america.10.a:0 "The frontier is not unclaimed land."
